how_tos.How to pay your credit card bill:
- Drop a cheque or use an NEFT/ RTGS/ IMPS at any ICICI Bank branch.
- Pay via any ICICI Bank branch.
- Request that the bill amount be automatically debited from your ICICI Bank account.
- You can access your account through the internet or mobile banking and pay your bill through your ICICI Bank account.
- You can use Click to Pay, or NEFT through your full banking, or any other account.
- You can also call customer care to pay your credit card bill by providing them the necessary information.
how_tos.How to get a replacement card: If your card is lost, misplaced or damaged, requests for a new card can be made through the ICICI Bank customer service internet banking or at the Bank branch. The lost card will be deblocked and instantly blocked through the replacement credit card and you will receive your card within 7 working days.

fees_and_charges.Annual Fee: Rs.3,500 (waived if more than Rs.1 lakh is spent in the previous year)
fees_and_charges.Cash advance transaction charge: Rs. 300 or 2.5% of transaction amount, whichever is higher
fees_and_charges.Rewards redemption: Rs. 99 + service tax is levied for handling and courier
fees_and_charges.Outstation cheque processing charge: 2% of the cheque amount, subject to a minimum of Rs. 100
fees_and_charges.Cheque return: 2% of the total amount payable, subject to a minimum of Rs. 250
fees_and_charges.Auto Debit return fee: Rs. 200 or 2% of the total amount payable, whichever is higher
fees_and_charges.Overlimit: Rs. 500 or 2.5% of the overlimit amount, whichever is higher

miscellaneous: ICICI Bank Sapphiro VISA credit card is embedded with microchip technology that enhances the security of your card. It gives you additional protection against frauds, counterfeiting and card skimming. Plus, the added layer of the Personal Identification Number will ensure you verify each transaction.

faqs.When will I receive my welcome offer fro: After you start using the ICICI Bank Sapphiro credit card, you will receive the complimentary set of Boat EZ Audio Headphones within 30 days.
faqs.How safe is it to use my credit card for: Your credit card is secured with VISA to ensure that all online transactions are secured and safe for you. For online transactions, you need to provide your 3D Secure code/ Verified by VISA to proceed with the PIN which is required for any merchant website.
faqs.What happens if I default on my credit c: When you default, an interest rate is automatically applied to your charges. Depending on the amount you own the bank, the penalty will be levied. Apart from this, the interest rate can be up to 3.50% per month. For overdue payments on the minimum amount on your credit card that has to be paid, follow the protocol and report to ICICI. This will affect your credit score. Ensure you pay at least the minimum due to avoid these consequences.
